findings.issue: `spinHalf` is declared in `PhyslibAlpha.Sl2.AngularMomentumRepresentation`, which already contains `standard n`, whose `n = 1` case is the same spin-1/2 representation (`Jsq_standard` gives `(n/2)(n/2+1) = 3/4`); the file's own implementation note concedes `spinHalf` is `standard 1` up to carrier. The generic name records nothing about the realisation that distinguishes it (Pauli matrices on `EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin 2)`), so a consumer in that namespace cannot tell `spinHalf` from `standard 1`.

summary: Code-level names follow upstream and sibling-module precedent closely; two issues: the PR description advertises an API whose names do not exist at the head commit, and `spinHalf` collides in meaning with the `standard 1` already in the same namespace.
